name: bug
description: Something is not working as documented.

name: enhancement
description: New capability or meaningful improvement.

name: documentation
description: Documentation-only change or documentation issue.

name: performance
description: Measured runtime, memory, storage, or startup work.

name: security
description: Public security hardening only; disclose vulnerabilities privately.

name: dependencies
description: Dependency or toolchain updates.

name: question
description: Usage or design question.

name: breaking change
description: Changes a documented interface, storage format, or integration contract.

name: area: core
description: Storage, retrieval, ranking, redaction, or Git applicability.

name: area: cli
description: CLI behavior and local operator workflows.

name: area: mcp
description: MCP server, schemas, transport, or isolation.

name: area: integrations
description: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and other adapters.

name: area: evaluation
description: Fixtures, benchmarks, and reproducibility.

name: status: needs triage
description: Awaiting maintainer review and classification.

name: status: needs reproduction
description: More information or a minimal reproduction is required.

name: status: blocked
description: Waiting on an external decision or dependency.

name: good first issue
description: Small, well-scoped contribution with clear acceptance criteria.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome community implementation help.

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked elsewhere.

name: invalid
description: Not actionable as filed.

name: wontfix
description: Not planned or outside the project scope.
